answers.label: Benefits and challenges of consequential methods
answers.text:
While Trio supports including the impact of clean energy procurement to the grid because it can help direct capital toward higher-impact outcomes, the current proposal requires several refinements to enable broad adoption by reporting entities:
• Any estimate of avoided emissions from a project should be evaluated alongside the reporter’s induced (inventory) emissions to provide decision‑useful context on marginal impact per unit of investment. Corporate entities do not make investment decisions in a vacuum and need a frame of reference on the level of investment relative to their induced inventory of emissions.
• For meaningful uptake, this framework should be mandatory for inventory reporting. Project accounting is not a universally used emissions tracking method currently and will continue to not see adoption if it is viewed as an alternative or additional option, rather than a part of a reporting entity required inventory.

answers.label: Appropriateness of the TWG subgroup formula
Why the formula is or is not appropriate
answers.text: The proposed equation does not incorporate a paired view of induced (inventory) emissions for the reporting entity, limiting decision‑usefulness for capital allocation. Without a clear linkage to inventory metrics and standardized disclosures, there is a risk of inconsistent use and limited adoption by reporters.
